meta.purpose: Irregularities found during this session's line-by-line review of the root repository plus newly confirmed data-vintage differences. None block publication or merge; every item is published on the Flagged for Review page.

items.location: Root sources.json S17; risk pages citing CAL FIRE FHSZ
items.description: The CAL FIRE FHSZ URL cited in root sources.json (…/fire-hazard-severity-zones-maps-2022) returns 404 on dereference (verified 2026-11-08). Values on the risk pages (wildfire risk framing) were not changed by this session; only the link breaks.
items.status: OPEN - replacement URL published in this session's T17
items.resolution_action: Replace root S17 link with https://osfm.fire.ca.gov/what-we-do/community-wildfire-preparedness-and-mitigation/fire-hazard-severity-zones and re-verify before next root rebuild.

items.description: The CDI FAIR Plan consumer URL cited in root sources.json (…/01-resi/FAIR-Plan.cfm) returns 'Document Not Found' on dereference (verified 2026-11-08).
items.resolution_action: Root S20 should be updated to https://www.insurance.ca.gov/01-consumers/200-wrr/California-FAIR-Plan.cfm (now live; linked from CDI homepage).

items.location: Root metrics.json M16; any county-income cells
items.description: The Census QuickFacts county-only slug (lacountycalifornia) resolves to the U.S. aggregate page; county median household income and per-capita income were not confirmable via that URL this session.
items.resolution_action: Leave blank and flagged; capture county income from ACS table B19013/B19301 via data.census.gov when a session has capacity.

items.description: The UCERF3-specific USGS page previously cited returns 404 (verified 2026-11-08). Seismic probability figures circulating in earlier sessions (e.g., 60% M>=6.7/30yr) were not re-verified this session.
items.resolution_action: Treat UCERF3 probabilities as unverified in this session; cite USGS Earthquake Hazards Program page (T18) pending a live UCERF3 source.

items.location: All metric cells across root and session builds
items.description: Data vintages differ: root build as of 2026-11-06 (BLS Aug 2026, DGS10 4.90% on 11-04). This session reads September 2026 BLS (updated 2026-11-04), DGS10 4.84% on 2026-11-05, DFEDTARU 4.00% on 2026-11-08.
items.resolution_action: Both vintages are published side by side; no silent restatement of root cells.

items.location: Root valuation.json tax layer; Section 1031 state conformity
items.description: Whether California conforms to IRC Section 1031 for state income tax purposes was not independently confirmed this session (T14 confirms federal treatment only).
items.resolution_action: Add a California FTB confirmation step to the pre-decision checklist; do not publish state tax figures without it.

items.description: Poverty rate (M17) and per-capita income (M16) were blank in the root build.
items.resolution_action: Confirmed on live Census QuickFacts table 2026-11-08 (M16 $47,685; M17 16.5%); root cells remain frozen as prior-session record.
